svg.title: How an agent evaluates influence
svg.desc: The agent combines position, accepted receipts, information access, relationship state, future narrative value, and identity. A strategic lens organizes that evidence into a contextual estimate of who can move whom and what may happen next. The estimate supports several valid postures and is revised after outcomes.

span.p: Who can move whom? Who owes whom? Which story can stick? What changes next?
